purpose: Supersede the v3 evidence-strength boundary without rewriting v3: all 701 rows must carry a typed, executable, row-specific mathematical or logical derivation bound to an answer-free learner stimulus. Production answers and response contracts enter only after derivation, in a separate comparison layer.

immutablePredecessor.authorityBoundary: immutable predecessor evidence only; its 467 review-method classifications are not row-specific derivations and cannot satisfy final 701-row semantic acceptance

classificationOnlySet.tupleCanonicalSerialization: JSON.stringify(rows.map(({baseId, reviewMethodClassification}) => ({id: baseId, oldClassification: reviewMethodClassification, oldSolutionBasisSha256: SHA256(JSON.stringify(boundSemanticShardRowById.get(baseId).reviewBasis))})))

layer1SanitizedProblemInput.problemPayloadCanonicalSerialization: JSON.stringify({baseId: question.id, type: question.type, prompt: {en: question.promptEn, zh: question.promptZh}, options: {en: question.optionsEn ?? null, zh: question.optionsZh ?? null}, diagram: {present: Object.hasOwn(question, 'diagram'), value: question.diagram ?? null}})
layer1SanitizedProblemInput.boundary: This immutable artifact is the sole problem source visible to the derivation-author process. Required unit, method, and representation constraints must be extracted from the bilingual prompt itself; production response-contract metadata is deliberately excluded.

layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.factContract: Every fact is typed and has a row-local locator into the sanitized prompt, ordered options, or diagram. No fact may carry a production answer or accepted alias.
layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.stepContract: Every step is an executable typed operation that references declared fact/step IDs and yields a typed intermediate value; free prose alone is invalid.
layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.constructedResponseContract: Constructed-response rows must declare typed operands, relations or cases, units, requested method/format extracted from prompt, executable steps, and a computed result.
layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.multipleChoiceContract: Every MC row must include optionAdjudications[] with every option index exactly once, the exact localized option payload/hash, a boolean truth value computed from row facts, and a row-specific reason; exactly one option is true.
layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.generationProhibition: The supplement-author process must not import, read, receive, or derive from production answer, acceptedAnswers, learner explanations, response contracts, v3 reviewed answers, or any answer-bearing question source. Static import/source scans plus runtime injected-I/O tests must prove this boundary.
layer2AnswerBlindDerivation.answerIndependenceInvariant: Removing or blanking every production answer/acceptedAnswers field outside the sanitized artifact produces byte-identical supplement output. Mutating production answers never regenerates facts, steps, option adjudications, or computedResult.

layer3PostDerivationComparison.responsePolicyCanonicalSerialization: JSON.stringify(exact ID-scoped strict contract, simple contract, or explicit generic grading policy selected after derivation)
layer3PostDerivationComparison.comparisonBoundary: Only this layer may read production answer/acceptedAnswers or response-contract metadata. It compares the already computed result with production semantics; it cannot rewrite or regenerate the derivation.

requiredMutationMatrix.diagramMutation: every row with a diagram plus an absent-to-present injection gate
requiredMutationMatrix.unitMethodFormatMutation: every row whose prompt requires a unit, method, or representation

independentReReviewPlan.pass1: A reviewer who did not author the supplement recomputes every row from the sanitized prompt/options/diagram artifact only, records pass/fail and a short discrepancy note, and may not use production answers, accepted aliases, response contracts, or learner explanation text as an oracle.
independentReReviewPlan.pass2: A separate fail-closed executable validator checks exact problem hashes, fact locators, every typed derivation step, MC option truth tables, computed-result integrity, and only then compares units, requested method/format, canonical answers, accepted forms, and response policies.
independentReReviewPlan.acceptance: 701/701 typed row-specific derivations pass both gates, discrepancy IDs are empty, deterministic double-generation is byte-identical, every required mutation reaches its exact semantic failure code, and a frozen review receipt binds sanitized input, supplement, v4 oracle, builder, and validator SHA-256 values.
independentReReviewPlan.claimBoundary: Until the independent re-review receipt is complete, v4 remains a candidate evidence package and the overall HK all-question goal remains open.
